payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively checks all 4 possible assignments of rectangle dimensions (swapping a,b and c,d) to test if one dimension matches and the other two sum to that dimension.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a fixed set of conditional checks covering all combinations of side orientations, which is a simple permutation enumeration over 2x2 possibilities. There is no recursive backtracking or graph traversal.
